name: Vcherashnee Zavtra
source:
The story takes place in one city, which is a composite image, with some Japanese architecture and some Russian cultural elements.
She, Melissa, has met and made a friend who will soon visit her city to see her in person.
They are waiting for new different people, events, internal moral choices, solutions to psychological problems, and relationships with the outside world.
Melissa likes to wear this type of clothing, take care of animals, and try to help people, but she finds it difficult to deal with her issues on her own. She has a psychological disorder and needs to overcome this problem and find answers, and she is very happy to have a friend.
Her best friend Robert is trying to help her. Maybe they'll start a relationship, or maybe they won't. In addition, she has a cousin named Hanna Fokina. Together, they're ready to confront the antihero, Comrade Krepov, and his "right-hand man," Hanna Fokina. However, it's important to understand their perspective as well.

他们正在等待新的不同的人、事件、内在的道德选择、心理问题的解决方案以及与外部世界的关系。
梅丽莎喜欢穿这种衣服，照顾动物，并尝试帮助人们，但她发现自己很难解决自己的问题。她有心理障碍，需要克服这个问题并寻找答案，她很高兴有一个朋友。
她最好的朋友罗伯特正在试图帮助她。也许他们会开始一段关系，也可能不会。此外，她还有一个表弟，名叫汉娜·福金娜。他们准备一起对抗反英雄克列波夫同志和他的“得力助手”汉娜·福基纳。然而，了解他们的观点也很重要。
